g.text: PR #2410 · Stop repeated disconnect alerts for old sessions
A connected proxy can be idle; reconnecting it does not create new work.
Only interrupted work can alert, once per accepted input across restarts.
BEFORE
AFTER
SessionDisconnected
Proxy teardown, launch failure or startup sweep
Candidate emitted on an active-to-disconnected drop.
Registration can make an old idle session active.
SessionDisconnected
The same producers emit disconnect candidates.
Preferences, mute, presence and subscriptions checked.
Only eligible recipients reach the new claim.
dispatch_one
Every enabled disconnect event reaches fan-out.
No check for unfinished agent work.
No durable record of a previous disconnect alert.
Each reconnect/drop can notify again.
claim_disconnect
Require disconnected status and paused = false.
persisted_activity_states must report Busy.
Claim session_disconnect_notifications.input_seq.
Only a higher input_seq can replace the claim.
Repeated alerts for the same session
Old completed session drops: alert.
Proxy reconnects, then drops again: another alert.
Server restart forgets any transient context.
Notification collapse does not prevent new deliveries.
One attempt for interrupted work
Idle or recovered session: silent.
Same input after reconnect or restart: silent.
New input rearms the disconnect alert.
The first claim fans out to all subscribed devices.
Delivery stays best-effort: a failed or partial fan-out is not retried by reconnecting the same input.
